description: This file defines the implementation of the VertexBuffer class and related classes such as VertexBufferInterface, StreamingVertexBufferInterface, and StaticVertexBufferInterface, which handle graphics API agnostic vertex buffer operations for Direct3D in the ANGLE project.

classes.name: VertexBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class managing reference counting and serial number for vertex buffers.

classes.name: VertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing vertex buffer operations, including size, serial, and discard.

classes.name: StreamingVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for streaming dynamic vertex buffers with space reservation and attribute storage.

classes.name: StaticVertexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for static vertex buffers with attribute signature matching and static attribute storage.

classes.name: AttributeSignature
classes.description: Helper class for matching and setting attribute signatures in static vertex buffers.

methods.name: updateSerial
methods.description: Updates the serial number for the vertex buffer.

methods.name: getSerial
methods.description: Returns the serial number of the vertex buffer.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Decrements reference count and deletes object if count reaches zero.

methods.name: setBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the vertex buffer.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards the contents of the vertex buffer.

methods.name: storeVertexAttributes
methods.description: Stores vertex attribute data into the buffer.
